home.title: Blume | Make Every Day a Healthy Skin Day
home.description: Hi, we're Blume and we're all up in your bathroom with products that are good for you, and the environment. Award winning skin care. Clean, effective and affordable.
home.fit: **Core skincare, strong fit.** Hormonal-acne focus with a clear hero SKU and a young audience that is native to UGC. Two claim cautions: 'Works in Just 3 Days' is a specific time-bound efficacy claim, and 'Dermatologist Recommended' appears as a homepage heading — both need substantiation on file before creative repeats them. Heavy bundle discounting (43–50%) alongside 310 active ads suggests margin pressure.
